row.evidence: Axure's pricing page puts "User management & single sign-on" in the Contact-us Enterprise tier (Axure Cloud for Business), and its admin docs cover SAML 2.0 SSO, manual member adds and deactivation, and on-premises AD/LDAP, with no SCIM or provisioning API.
row.notes: New row. Annual billing shown by default: Axure RP Pro $29 and Team $49 per user/month (monthly $34 and $57). SAML SSO needs Axure Cloud for Business (Enterprise, contact sales; private instance or on-premises). No SCIM, no public user-management API, and no IdP catalogue apps: the Okta, Entra and Google guides set up custom/non-gallery SAML apps. Users are added manually in the Members page (optionally flagged Use SSO) and deactivated manually; on-premises servers can authenticate against Active Directory or LDAP. Status none by absence.
